nodes.description: Pathogenic PRPH2 variants perturb peripherin-2 complex formation at photoreceptor outer-segment rims, especially through the D2 loop and PRPH2/ROM1 oligomer interface. As an outer-segment structural-protein gene defect expressed in rod and cone photoreceptors, this is the initiating lesion of the conserved photoreceptor-degeneration cascade.
